title: Weekly sprint reports: see what got done each week, on the phone and in the Mac app, from the tasks agents complete
user_said: i want to add a feature in the phone app and mac app to show the list of recently completed things very much like a sprint report, time bound (drop down for date ranges, etc). i think we do a 1 week sprint, aligned to claude token spend (start of the week session). but for this to be meaningful, agents need to work with tasks.
